title.narrative: Accessible and Equitable Justice for Women and Youth (AEJ-Way) Project

description.narrative: Gender injustice and youth negligence are pervasive and widespread in Africa and very little has been done to avert the trend. For most of the time the issue in the fore has been gender equity with youth empowerment and justice merely receiving lip service. Bringing justice for women will be encompassing if it is chalked up with equity and opportunity for the young men and women in whose hands lie the future. The most veritable tool to combat the trend is advocacy and practical effort in putting the energies into productive ventures. Dealing with the issues of women and youth injustice is a foolproof approach to ensuring that the human ecology is peaceful and intergenerational equity is attained. The AEJ-Way project therefore aims to bring the plight of women and youth to the fore and place them in a position where they can make positive impacts to change the current turbulent social and environmental narrative in Plateau State.
